full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 1-4 contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material statements made in the plaint. Their case, in short, is that the suit plot No. 91 of Chandpur Municipality appertains to C.S. Khatian No. 327 and S.A. Khatian Nos. 272-273, old Holding Nos. 183/205 and present Holding Nos. 353/308. The shops including the suit shop originally belonged to Tofazzal Hossain, father of the defendants. On 16.03.1983, the plaintiff became tenant under landlord Tofazzal Hossain, the father of the defendants. After that, the father of the defendants died on 01.02.1997 and the defendants requested the plaintiff to renew the contract of lease but the plaintiff did not "renew the same. The plaintiff earlier filed Title Suit No. 54 of 1988, in which, the father of the defendants was the defendant and subsequently, on 16.07.2001, the same abated against which, the appeal prepared by the plaintiff has been pending. The defendant’s bonafide require the premises for construction and accordingly they got a plan approved by the proper authority. Thereafter, all the tenants left their shops except the plaintiff. Thereafter, a Shalish was held in the Chamber of the learned Advocate, Ruhul Amin Sarker and accordingly, on 20.07.2001, the plaintiff vacated the shop on mutual agreement and as such, the suit is not maintainable and liable to be dismissed.
